data.title: Nowhere to hide: Tech selloff hits software and chip stocks alike
data.summary_raw: The software and semiconductor sectors haven’t been trading in tandem much this year, but they collectively fell Friday as AI and interest-rate fears hit the market.

data.title: Could an Anthropic IPO put your 401(k) at risk? The AI safety debate hits a new dimension.
data.summary_raw: Anthropic and New York City’s comptroller have opened a line of communication to discuss “existential risks” posed by AI and what that could mean for the company’s future stock.

data.title: The bond market shrugged off two inflation shocks. Why stock investors should pay attention.
data.summary_raw: Hot CPI and PPI data should have pushed Treasury yields higher. Instead, bond buyers stepped in to suggest yields have risen high enough to become attractive for investors.

data.title: New SEC rules would fleece everyday investors to enrich Wall Street
data.summary_raw: New proposals from the Securities and Exchange Commission will tilt the scales in favor of Wall Street and against a huge group of retail investors.
